description: This is a PHPUnit/Codeception test class for the API endpoint /Api/V8/meta/fields in the SuiteCRM project, specifically testing the retrieval of metadata about fields for modules like Accounts and handling invalid modules.

classes.name: GetFieldsMetaCest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of the /meta/fields API endpoint in SuiteCRM's V8 API, including both successful and error scenarios.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Logs in the test user before each test.

methods.name: shouldWork
methods.description: Tests the successful retrieval of field metadata from the Accounts module.

methods.name: shouldNotWork
methods.description: Tests the API's response when requesting a non-existent or unauthorized module.

methods.name: shouldWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for the shouldWork test case.

methods.name: shouldNotWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for the shouldNotWork test case.
